field_principles.flagged_for_v383: Closes the discover->ingest->plan loop: names the strongest method for the next planner.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. Records ingestion completed with verifiable citations.
field_principles.methods_mapped: Each method/source MUST carry a real arXiv ID or canonical doc URL; an ingestion note without verifiable citations is treated as fabrication.

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Loading weights only or restarting the trainer silently rewinds the warmup/cosine schedule and fabricates long-horizon progress.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Resume nano-trm bounded passes with Trainer.fit(..., ckpt_path=...) so global_step, optimizer state, and LR scheduler state continue.
methods_mapped.name: PyTorch Lightning full-state checkpoint resume

methods_mapped.failure_mode: A model-only checkpoint loses momentum buffers and parameter-group learning rates, causing an unreported resume discontinuity.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: If a run bypasses Lightning, persist model state, optimizer state, epoch or step, LR scheduler state, data cursor, and RNG receipt.
methods_mapped.name: PyTorch optimizer-state checkpoint contract

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Counting microbatches as optimizer steps overstates the training horizon and moves the LR schedule at the wrong rate.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Use accumulate_grad_batches or GradientAccumulationScheduler to keep effective batch size explicit across microbatches and bounded passes.
methods_mapped.name: Lightning gradient-accumulation schedule

methods_mapped.failure_mode: A checkpoint can reload correctly while still being an undertrained partial baseline, especially if LR state was reset.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Accumulate resumed nano-trm Sudoku evidence by global optimizer step and held-out exact accuracy before any verifier-lift claim.
methods_mapped.name: TRM long-horizon baseline gate

methods_mapped.failure_mode: Full fine-tuning can win through adaptation compute alone, and a per-pass LR reset confounds the verifier comparison.
methods_mapped.implementation_over_stack: Keep a no-verifier full-fine-tune control with the same accumulated optimizer-step budget and the same resumed LR schedule receipts.
methods_mapped.name: TTA-TRM bounded full-fine-tune control
